ItemPatch.description: Any editable field; never `state`. `null` clears category, location, price or date.
ItemPatch.title: ItemPatch

LocationPatch.description: `parent_id: null` moves the location to the top level; leaving it out keeps it.
LocationPatch.title: LocationPatch

Proposal.description: A value read from the photo (`ocr`) or suggested by Gemini, never trusted unconfirmed.
Proposal.title: Proposal

SettingsPatch.description:
Any subset of the settings; a key that is present must carry a real value.

Strict: the string "yes" is not a boolean and "7" is not a number of days.
SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch
